purpose: Post-live-run hardening and documentation refresh for CanDoItAll Processes after a full Blazor app delivery process completed.
strategy: Stabilize generic process runtime, close prior proof debt, refactor high-risk services, and update docs/skills/templates before wider real process testing.
criticalRisks: Prior MAF/process final preflight bundle still had blocked broad integration proof and race/hash recovery proof.
Recent output grounding and manager chat fixes were targeted and successful, but broader integration tests still had failures outside final proof scope.
